fields.title: 📖 Akhlāq means goodness toward the family
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The best of you are the best to their families.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True character shows itself not only outside before people, but especially where one has authority, closeness, and daily life.

immutable.source: 📝 at-Tirmidhī, al-Jāmiʿ, Kitāb al-Manāqib, Hadith: Khayrukum Khayrukum li-Ahlihi.
